title: juicy midnight tunisian couscous tagine
description: this funky, juicy, midnight-craving tunisian dish is a perfect combination of char-grill-y flavors, ayurvedic sattvic friendly ingredients, and the warmth of a raclette grill. a comforting meal to satisfy your late-night cravings.
instructions: season the chicken breasts with salt, black pepper, and a pinch of turmeric
grill the chicken for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked through
fluff the couscous in a large mixing bowl
add 2 cups of hot water to the couscous and let it sit for 5 minutes
fluff the couscous with a fork and add 2 tablespoons of olive oil, 1 tablespoon of chopped fresh parsley, and 1 tablespoon of chopped fresh cilantro
serve the grilled chicken on top of the couscous mixture
garnish with additional parsley and cilantro if desired
